classification.factor_preference: requires favorable subject-mean sign in at least 2/3 subjects and favorable grand mean; otherwise TIE/NULL
classification.wall_clock_advantage: for at least one resampled k40 comparator, fixed spectral reaches that comparator's epoch-500 LEW earlier in >=6/9 runs and >=2/3 subject means

heldout_gate: fixed spectral improves fixed uniform in >=2/3 development subject means
grand mean paired normalized AUC difference is negative
fixed spectral divergence/NaN count does not exceed fixed uniform
all nonzero normalized applied update norms match the common target within 1e-10 relative
fixed spectral has the preregistered wall-clock advantage over a resampled k40 comparator
prohibited: heldout or BNCI before a passing development gate

reference.reuse_decision: rerun: no frozen trajectory matches development subjects x all seeds x 500 epochs x both controls
